experiments.name: CubeSat thermal-vacuum cycling qualification per NASA LSP-REQ-317.01 Rev B (-14 to +71 C, 1e-4 torr)
experiments.plain_name: Space-qualify a small CubeSat satellite by cycling it hot and cold in a vacuum chamber
experiments.description: Qualification thermal-vacuum cycling of a 3U CubeSat for a NASA Launch Services Program ride: the satellite is cycled over at least -14 C to +71 C at a chamber pressure of 13.3e-3 Pa (1e-4 torr) with functional tests at the soaks, as summarised from LSP-REQ-317.01 Rev B in the INPE ICES-2017 test-specification method; the article envelope is the CubeSat Design Specification 3U size.

requirements.rationale: LSP-REQ-317.01 qualification requires at least the -14 C to +71 C range (-14 C = 259.15 K, +71 C = 344.15 K).

requirements.rationale: The test is a thermal-vacuum cycling test; an evacuated chamber is required.

experiments.name: ECSS-E-ST-10-03C space-segment equipment thermal vacuum test (<= 1e-5 hPa, functional tests at hot and cold)
experiments.plain_name: Test a satellite electronics unit in vacuum under the European space testing standard

requirements.rationale: Clause 5.5.4.2a: equipment operating in space vacuum must be tested in thermal vacuum.

requirements.document_title: ECSS-E-ST-10-03C Space engineering - Testing (1 June 2012)

requirements.rationale: Functional tests at hot and cold operating temperatures require powered, instrumented equipment inside the chamber.

requirements.rationale: Optional: functional tests start only after a dwell of at least 2 h, so the facility must hold a plateau for at least 2 h.
requirements.document_title: ECSS-E-ST-10-03C Space engineering - Testing (1 June 2012)
requirements.quote: g. Functional test shall only start after a dwell time greater or equal to 2 hours.
